company.name: AbuErdan
company.shortDescription: AbuErdan is a cloud-based poultry management solution that empowers poultry companies
company.description: AbuErdan provides poultry management solutions including artificial intelligence, broiler management, breeder, hatchery, slaughterhouse, and layer management solutions. Their customers  inquiries are addressed by phone, email, and physical address.

productsAndServices.description: A system that integrates all divisions of a poultry company to provide unified management, analytics, and traceability across the entire value chain.
productsAndServices.name: Integrated Value-chain Management

productsAndServices.description: Uses deep learning and predictive analytics to forecast poultry performance and assist in operational planning and supply chain forecasting.
productsAndServices.name: Artificial Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: Tracks and analyzes performance metrics for broiler chicken operations to support timely decision-making and operational control.
productsAndServices.name: Broilers Management

productsAndServices.description: Monitors detailed operational data for breeders and integrates with hatchery data to provide comprehensive production indicators.
productsAndServices.name: Breeders Management

productsAndServices.description: Collects and correlates hatchery data to connect breeders with broilers or chick sales, tracking production KPIs and generating analysis reports.
productsAndServices.name: Hatchery Management

productsAndServices.description: Monitors quality, supply, yield, equipment usage, and supply consumption in slaughterhouse operations to support management control.
productsAndServices.name: Slaughterhouse Management
